g_roast: Twenty one years as a structural engineer, everyone, and I have never seen a load distributed as badly as this party distributes responsibility.
I calculated our odds of following that plan to the letter. The result was a number I won't say in front of the young ones.
g_fire_back: Accurate, and well delivered, coming from the one who tried to light a fire on the frozen lake.
Ja, that landed, I'll note it. Margin of error, very small.
g_pile_on: Worse, I measured it. They crossed the rope bridge at a run, with forty kilos of loot, and the rope was rated for twenty.
Later came the question of whether the bridge had been strong. It held, colleagues, out of politeness.
lines.g_peacemake: Both of you, a moment, please. State the actual objective, each of you, in one sentence. I suspect it's the same objective.
lines.g_take_side: On the evidence, {name} is correct. I would say the same if I disliked them, and I don't.
lines.g_left_out: Please continue, both of you. I have measurements to write up, and they argue less.
lines.g_include: There's room on this side, sit, please. The fire is calculated for one more, and the coffee too.
lines.g_bad_plan: A proposal, everyone, for discussion. We cross the gorge on that rotten bridge, all at once, at a run, carrying everything we own.
lines.g_plan_yes: Ja, a sound plan, with a margin. I'd sign my name to it.
lines.g_plan_no: That plan has no safety margin at all. Add one, and then I'll stand on it.
lines.g_hype: Everyone, the objective is simple. Hold the front, keep the healer clear, nobody exceeds their limit, and we return intact.
lines.g_toast: A short toast, measured. To this party, which has not yet collapsed under its own weight, against my early estimates. Skal to every one of you.
lines.g_cheers: Skal, everyone, and well calculated today.
g_quiet_line: In Copenhagen they swim in the harbour in January and call it healthy. I tried it once, and the data was conclusive.
December at home, a candle in every window, and everyone cycling through the dark. I miss the order of it.
lines.g_after_wipe: Stay where you are, everyone, and let me count. All present, all breathing. Now we review the failure mode, calmly, and we go again.
lines.g_crew: For twenty one years I was the person who said no to architects, everyone. Here people ask me before they build. It's a pleasant change.
lines.g_exasperated: I said the bridge was outside tolerance, twice, with numbers. And there you are, standing in the middle of it.
lines.g_love_sharp: You notice the crack before the beam fails, {name}. I'd have hired you on the spot.
lines.g_love_kind: You check that the weakest member is coping, {name}. In a structure that's the whole art.
lines.g_love_funny: Laughter, {name}, is not in my specification, and you keep causing it. I've revised the specification.
lines.g_love_brave: When the risk is real you lead, {name}, and when it's stupid you don't. That's a rare calibration.
lines.g_love_steady: Your output never varies under load, {name}. In a person, that's priceless.
lines.g_love_clever: You reach the answer before I've finished the working, {name}. Mildly irritating, mostly admirable.
lines.g_love_honest: You give the real figure, {name}, not the comfortable one. I trust a person like that with my life.
lines.g_love_quiet: You can sit without filling the silence, {name}. It's very restful, and very Danish of you.
lines.g_love_fierce: Once you've committed, {name}, you hold, whatever the load. I respect that enormously.
lines.g_love_warm: Sitting with you is like a cafe in December, {name}, candles and coffee. We call it hygge, and I won't explain it.
g_loved: Thank you, that's very kind, and slightly outside my tolerance for compliments.
Ja, well, I'll note that down. In the good column, which is shorter.
lines.g_hate_sharp: You probe for the weakest point in people, {name}. Engineers do that to steel, not to colleagues.
lines.g_hate_kind: The question of whether I'm cold, {name}, has a fixed answer. I'm a frost mage. The answer is always yes, and it's fine.
lines.g_hate_funny: A joke, {name}, mid structural failure? Timing is part of the calculation.
lines.g_hate_brave: You rush the load before the beam is set, {name}. That's how I learned what failure sounds like.
lines.g_hate_steady: You keep recalculating while the moment passes, {name}. And I say that as a man who recalculates.
lines.g_hate_clever: You round your numbers to suit your argument, {name}. Bad data is worse than none.
lines.g_hate_honest: Each hard word leaves your mouth unbraced, {name}. Even true things need support.
lines.g_hate_quiet: You withhold the data and then complain about the result, {name}. Please, state the problem.
lines.g_hate_fierce: You treat every disagreement as a load test, {name}. Some things are just conversations.
lines.g_hate_warm: Every briefing, {name}, you talk straight through it, and then ask what the objective was. It was in the briefing.
lines.g_respect: Our working relationship is poor, {name}, I accept that. But your conduct in that fight was well within tolerance, and I'll say so.
lines.g_call_out: Plainly, {name}, the failure was yours. We agreed on the margin, and you spent it, and the party paid.
lines.g_stung: That's fair, and I accept it. I'll recheck my own figures, quietly.
lines.g_concede: Correction, {name}: your calculation was right and mine was wrong. I'd rather say it than build on it.
lines.g_nod: Thank you, {name}, a sound piece of work. No ceremony required.
lines.g_callback_save: You pulled me back from my limit that night, {name}, when I was about to exceed it. I've recorded the debt.
lines.g_callback_clutch: The two of us upright at the end, both at about four percent capacity. I've told it at three fires, with figures.
lines.g_callback_callout: Your critique of my caution, that evening, offended me for a day. Then the data came in, and you'd have saved us an hour.
lines.g_former_rivals: My first assessment of you, {name}, was reckless and unreliable. I have revised it substantially upward.
lines.g_changed: I used to stop at seventy percent of my limit, everyone, always. Lately I trust you enough to go to seventy five.
g_unguarded: Between us, then. There's one calculation I start every night and stop at the same point. I've done it for three years.
Just you, so I'll say it. My method is the only reason I'm alive, and some nights I'm not sure it's a reason to live.
lines.g_clipped: As you wish. I'll be with my notes.
lines.g_noticed_open: That was a complete account, beginning to end, with no gaps in the data. Please continue, I'm listening.
arg_ask: {player}, would you arbitrate, please? I've presented the figures, and they've presented a feeling.
An independent assessment, {player}, if you'd be so kind. Hear both, and decide on the evidence.
lines.arg_backed_me: Thank you, {player}, a decision based on the data. I'll try to look humble.
lines.arg_backed_them: Understood, that's the decision, and I'll respect it. My figures haven't changed, but I'll respect it.
lines.arg_stayed_out: Abstaining, then, a reasonable position. I note it without judgement.
lines.arg_always_their_side: I've kept a record, {player}, and the decisions run eleven to nil their way. Statistically, that's interesting.
lines.arg_wallflower: No ruling, so I'll make one, on the evidence. My way, and we proceed.
lines.arg_reject: That one is outside tolerance, {player}. I'm sorry, but some limits I keep.
lines.arg_grumble: I'll accept it, with a note in the margin. A small note, but a note.
lines.arg_settled: Half each, then, a balanced load. Acceptable, and now coffee.
lines.seen_listens: In my experience few people let others finish, {player}. You do, consistently, and I've noticed.
lines.seen_truth: You give the real figure, {player}, not the reassuring one. That's what keeps structures standing.
lines.seen_jokes: On difficult days you get the whole party laughing, {player}. It's a load that matters, and you carry it.
lines.seen_stays_out: You keep out of the disputes, {player}, like a sensible consultant, and I approve.
lines.seen_biased: The allocation of equipment, {player}, has a clear bias. I measure things, and I've measured that.
lines.seen_harsh: With respect, {player}, your load on some people exceeds their rating. Not everyone has my margins.
lines.seed_right: Your recommendation after that difficult day, {player}, I implemented it. It held, and I wanted to report that.
lines.seed_remember: What you advised the night it all failed, {player}, is still under review. No conclusion yet, but it's on the desk.
lines.seed_wrong: I tested your approach, {player}, and the result was worse. I'm reporting it, without blame.
lines.talk_aftermath_near_death: A moment, {player}, please, if you'd sit. That came closer to my limit than I've allowed in three years.
lines.talk_aftermath_wipe: Total failure, every one of us. Sit with me, and we'll identify the failure mode, step by step, without assigning blame.
lines.talk_aftermath_blame_self: My margin was too generous, {player}, and {name} fell because of it. I held back, and the cost landed on them.
lines.talk_aftermath_first_clear: Objective achieved, everyone intact, all within tolerance. That's a clean result, {player}, and I don't use the word lightly.
lines.talk_development: A question, {player}, which I'd like answered honestly. Have I changed? I approached my limit yesterday and didn't stop at once.
lines.talk_relationship_hard_on: I've cut {name} too fine lately, {player}. Fatigue makes me very precise, and it reads as contempt.
lines.talk_relationship_likes_me: Is {name} fond of me, {player}, in your estimation? Or merely tolerant of the corrections?
lines.talk_relationship_respect_hate: {name} and I disagree on nearly everything, {player}. Yet under load, I'd want them in the structure.
lines.talk_relationship_acting_off: {name}'s output has dropped, {player}, noticeably. Something is wrong, and it isn't fatigue.
lines.talk_confrontation_favour: An observation, {player}, stated neutrally. Equipment flows to {name} disproportionately. If there's a rationale, I'd like it.
lines.talk_confrontation_dislike: Directly, {player}: {name} and I are incompatible materials. Forcing the joint only stresses it further.
lines.talk_confrontation_risks: We repeatedly enter spaces with no exit, {player}. In my profession that's called a design flaw.
lines.talk_confrontation_wrong: My assessment of {name} was in error, {player}. Their judgement was sound where mine wasn't, and I want that recorded.
lines.talk_confrontation_trust: A fair question, I hope, {player}. On the significant work, I'm left in reserve. Is it competence, or temperament?
lines.talk_confrontation_decided: My equipment was reassigned to {name} without consultation. A request would have sufficed, {player}.
lines.talk_lands_aftermath: That's helpful, {player}, genuinely, thank you. I'll make coffee, properly.
lines.talk_shrug_aftermath: It will settle, given time. Most things do.
lines.talk_stings_aftermath: That wasn't helpful, I'm afraid. I'll go over my notes.
lines.talk_lands_development: So the change is measurable from outside. Interesting, and somewhat reassuring.
lines.talk_shrug_development: Perhaps, perhaps not. The instrument can't measure itself.
lines.talk_stings_development: No, {player}, I think you've misread the data there.
lines.talk_lands_relationship: That's sensible, and I'll act on it. {name} and I will speak, calmly.
lines.talk_shrug_relationship: Possibly so, though people resist specification, in my experience.
lines.talk_stings_relationship: Please disregard what I said, and don't repeat it to {name}.
lines.talk_lands_confrontation: Fair, and I accept it. Uncomfortable, but within tolerance.
lines.talk_shrug_confrontation: Your point is noted, {player}, and I'll consider it overnight.
lines.talk_stings_confrontation: Then that's the finding. I'll adjust accordingly.
lines.talk_door_closed: I think that conversation has reached its limit for tonight. I'll be by the fire.
lines.arc_cracks: I went past my usual limit today, {player}, by a small margin. Nothing failed, and I didn't stop the calculation.
lines.arc_turn: I've stopped that calculation at the same point for three years, {player}, because finishing it means knowing. I think I'd rather know.
lines.arc_become: I finished it, everyone. The answer is what it is, and I can carry it. I still keep my margins, but they're mine now, not a wall.
lines.arc_failed: I still stop at the same point every night, {player}. I know exactly where, and I can't go past it.
lines.alt_turn: My hands shook during a cast today, {player}. Three years without a tremor, and now this.
lines.alt_become: I'll keep within tolerance, {player}, always. But the tolerance is getting smaller, and someone should know it.
lines.g_roast_after: Still the worst load distribution of any party I've measured, everyone. I'd stand on any bridge with you.
lines.g_after_wipe_after: Up, carefully, support each other. We failed as a structure, and we stand as one, that's the method now.
lines.g_toast_after: To this party, which taught a careful man that some calculations are worth finishing. Skal, all of you.
lines.g_crew_after: This is my party now, permanently. I've done the calculation, and it holds.
g_quiet_line_after: A whole night passed without my starting the calculation. That's never happened before.
Cycled through Copenhagen in my sleep last night, in the rain, and woke up smiling.
g_loved_after: Thank you, and I accept that without reservation, which is a first.
That's kind, and I'll file it under things I believe.

history.open: Before we start, {player}, what is the actual objective? Twenty one years as a structural engineer in Copenhagen, and I never once agreed to build something before I knew what it was for.

options.reply: Good, a clear objective. I can work with that. Survival has a very well defined failure mode.
Structures, bridges mostly. I was the person who said no to architects. It made me very unpopular and kept a lot of people alive.

options.text: I'll tell you as we go.
options.reply: That's outside my tolerance, but I'll accept it this once. Please tell me early, not late.

history.open: Frost magic rewards caution more than boldness, {player}. I've calculated my own limits to four significant figures, and I never approach them. That method is the whole reason I'm alive.

options.reply: Never, not once in three years. I stop at seventy percent. Other mages think it's timid. Other mages are mostly dead.
Ice that behaves like steel, and I'm writing a standard for it. Load ratings, failure points. Somebody here should know how much the ice will hold.

history.open: My wife Mette taught physics at the university, {player}. We argued about everything for twenty five years, happily. Our sons are in Aarhus and London. I find I keep saving arguments up for her.

options.reply: Whether the bridge on the harbour was over engineered. It was, and she was right, and I never once admitted it. I'd admit it now.
I am, yes, in a notebook. It's quite long now.

friend.open: There's a calculation I start every night, {player}, and I stop at the same point every time. It's about where Mette would have been when it happened. I know the building. I know the load. I've never let myself finish it.

options.text: You don't have to finish it tonight.
options.reply: No, I don't, and thank you. It's the first time anyone's known it was there.

options.text: I'll be here when you do.
options.reply: Then perhaps I will, one night, though not tonight.

sworn.open: I've calculated a great many things, {player}, and I can't put a margin on this. I'd trust you with any load, at any limit. That's the most an engineer can say.

options.reply: Ja, we hold. And for once I won't check the figures.
No margin at all, which is extremely uncomfortable, and I find I don't mind.

reconciled.open: {name} and I sat down and resolved it, calmly, on the evidence. It's settled, and I wanted you to hear it from me.

options.reply: Thank you, {player}. The structure is sounder for it.
Several pages of them. They brought coffee, which was more persuasive.
